glm-5.3-flash.description: GLM 5.3 Flash vision chat OCR; 1M context, 128K host output; AutoShow requests at most 32,768 output tokens per page
glm-5.3-flash.pricingNotes: $0.15/M input and $0.50/M completion tokens, including reasoning once. Cached input $0.03/M; estimates conservatively ignore discounts. Page-token and latency heuristics are uncalibrated; not a spending bound.

limits.notes: https://docs.z.ai/guides/vlm/glm-5.3-flash documents vision chat and mandatory thinking. AutoShow restricts input to one PNG/JPEG page <=10 MiB per request; PDFs are rasterized locally.
